basic_info.description: This modern 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers a prime location near Stonestown Galleria, San Francisco State University, Lake Merced, Harding Park, The Olympic Club, San Francisco Golf Course, and Westlake Shopping Center. Enjoy easy freeway access to the peninsula, MUNI lines for downtown travel, and other public transit options. The home's contemporary design features an ideal floor plan. The main level boasts an open kitchen with upgraded Viking appliances and a large island that flows into the living and dining areas. A spacious balcony off the living and dining area, plus a powder room, complete this level. An interior stairway ascends seamlessly to the top floor, which offers 3 bedrooms and 2 baths, including a primary suite with a large balcony and a huge walk-in closet. Additional amenities include a side-by-side laundry closet, two-car deeded tandem parking, and solar panels.
